artifacts.summary: Plan v8: Redesign GeneralExistPart with 1-var NF parameters and zone decomposition to close 2 sorries in KampBypass.lean

memory_candidates.content: When a formal proof requires existential transfer across structures, the precondition of the transfer lemma must be satisfiable from hypotheses already available at the use site. If the transfer lemma's precondition IS the goal being proved (circular), the fix is to weaken the precondition to something available -- typically decomposing a multi-variable agreement into individual single-variable agreements that can be obtained from characteristic NF matching. The formula construction must then compensate by performing actual zone decomposition rather than using trivial top/bot formulas.
